messages:
Alex: Heads up — PR #9127 is ready for final approvals. Changes: adaptive prefetch tuning + a microbatch allocator guard. Ran a quick smoke bench, saw ~2% p50 improvement but a small p95 uptick on 2k sequences. Requesting 2 approvals for merge in today's 17:00 UTC slot if no blockers.

Priya: tagging in. can you paste the bench artifacts and the exact command you ran? want to replicate locally. :mag: 

Alex: Sure — artifacts here: https://artifacts.redwood.dev/builds/9127/bench-2026-03-16.zip
Command I ran locally: `./bench/run_microbench --config cfg/prefetch_tuned.yaml --seq-lens 512,2048 --runs 20`
Attached the raw output below.

Jamie: quick skim — thanks for the artifacts. Posting the summary I ran against the same commit on our dev gpu pool:
```
model: raven-3b
seq=2048 microbatch=8
baseline p50/p95: 32.1ms / 211.6ms
PR-9127 p50/p95: 31.4ms / 218.9ms
throughput delta: +3%
mem steady: +12MB
```
Looks like p95 moved ~7ms. need to know distribution (are tails from prefills or alloc retries).

Lucy: saw something similar on canary earlier — p95 regression concentrated on requests that hit a cold shard and did a fallback path. Noticed increased `alloc_retries` in logs.

Alex: thanks. I instrumented alloc retry counts in this PR. If retry > 1 we fallback to legacy allocator which costs the tail. I can add an extra guard to short-circuit to legacy earlier to prevent the retry loop. Would prefer to avoid reverting if small change nips this.

Priya: can you run the bench with `--capture-kv-stats` and upload logs? also please include `perf/heatmap` output so we can see tail ops.

Alex: uploaded extended run: https://artifacts.redwood.dev/builds/9127/bench-extended-2026-03-16.log.gz
Snippet of the heatmap I generated: `heatmap(p95) shows spike at token 192-256 during prefill`

CI-Bot: CI: premerge checks passed (linux + mac + bench smoke). Canary deploy passed basic SLOs for 2 hours. Link: https://ci.redwood.dev/9127/status

Jamie: ok can we add one more quick microbench for 4k seqs? the allocator path for longseq is different and might amplify the regression. If 4k stays flat I'm fine with approving.

Alex: running 4k now — ETA ~8m.

Lucy: also suggest gating merge on canary p95 staying within +5% over baseline for next 4 hours. If we hit that we revert automatically. Happy to sign off if guard added.

Alex: added canary rollback rule to the deployment config and pushed a tiny follow-up commit that short-circuits the retry loop. PR now has two commits.

Priya: I pulled and ran 4k run on my end, results attached: `p95 baseline 420ms -> PR 432ms (+2.9%)` — good. LGTM from me. :thumbsup:

Jamie: ran the 4k too, similar numbers. leaving one small nits comment but not blocking. LGTM.

Lucy: thanks — approving from ops side. :white_check_mark:

Alex: great — scheduling merge in 17:00 UTC slot. If CI or canary alerts in that window, I'll revert immediately. Thanks everyone for quick turnaround.

CI-Bot: merge scheduled at 17:00 UTC. Will post canary metrics link after deploy.

Alex: will monitor and report back in this thread after the canary completes.
